author: RIM team
description: Watches the GitHub releases of public repositories you choose and posts the latest ones into the open conversation. Talks only to GitHub, without a token.

commands.title: Releases: Add repository
commands.description: Adds a public GitHub repository to the list, at most 10.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.description: The repository as owner/name, such as rust-lang/rust.

commands.title: Releases: Remove repository
commands.description: Removes a repository from the list.

commands.title: Releases: Post to this conversation
commands.description: Posts the latest release of each repository on the list, or of the one you name, into the open conversation.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.description: One repository on the list, as owner/name; all of them when left out.

commands.title: Releases: Latest
commands.description: Answers the latest release of each repository on the list and refreshes the panel.

panels.title: Releases
panels.description: The latest releases of the repositories on your list.
